# Markdown Preview

> Native macOS app for reading Markdown files. Mac-native feel with Quick Look, document outline, and "Open With" handoff to your editor.

The website at mdpreview.app is the landing page and download portal for Markdown Preview, a macOS application distributed as a DMG via GitHub Releases.

## Resources

- [Source repository](https://github.com/pluk-inc/markdown-preview)
- [Latest release (DMG download)](https://github.com/pluk-inc/markdown-preview/releases/latest/download/Markdown-Preview.dmg)
- [All releases](https://github.com/pluk-inc/markdown-preview/releases)
